feat: parse git+https sourcehut urls (#345)

`fromUrl()` now accepts `git+https:` URLs for sourcehut. Previously,
`fromUrl('git+https://git.sr.ht/~foo/bar')` returned `undefined`, even
though the plain `https:` form and `git+ssh:` were already supported.

```js
hostedGitInfo.fromUrl('git+https://git.sr.ht/~foo/bar.git#branch').https()
// https://git.sr.ht/~foo/bar#branch
```

These URLs behave the same as the existing `https:` form: the default
representation is `https`, a `.git` suffix is stripped, and `https()`
and `toString()` return the plain `https://git.sr.ht/~owner/repo` URL.

`fromManifest()` already removed a leading `git+` before parsing, so
this only changes `fromUrl()`. Other hosts are not affected, and
